async def act(page):
    """Click the second-to-last search result on the current Search Results page.

    Current page already shows search results for 'playbook'. The second-to-last
    result is the middle heading: "Revealing the unknown unknowns in your software".
    We first attempt to dismiss any visible overlay (Escape, then common close buttons),
    then click the link using the full accessibility path: main -> heading -> link.
    The click is the final action because it will navigate away.
    """
    import re

    # 1) Try to dismiss common overlays/popups so the click is not intercepted.
    try:
        await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Try close-like buttons (names or glyphs like ×, ✕, X)
    try:
        close_pattern = re.compile(r"^(close|dismiss|close dialog|close window)$|[×✕Xx]", re.I)
        close_buttons = page.get_by_role("button", name=close_pattern)
        try:
            cb_count = await close_buttons.count()
        except Exception:
            cb_count = 0
        if cb_count > 0:
            await close_buttons.nth(0).click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(250)
    except Exception:
        # ignore failures to query/click close buttons
        pass

    # short pause to let UI settle
    await page.wait_for_timeout(200)

    # 2) Locate main and target heading/link using full parent->child path and click it.
    main = page.get_by_role("main")
    try:
        await main.wait_for(timeout=5000)
    except Exception:
        # If waiting by role times out, continue; subsequent locators will raise if absent
        pass

    # Full path: main -> heading -> link
    heading_locator = main.get_by_role(
        "heading",
        name="Revealing the unknown unknowns in your software",
        exact=True,
    )

    link_locator = heading_locator.get_by_role(
        "link",
        name="Revealing the unknown unknowns in your software",
        exact=True,
    )

    # Final action: click the link (may navigate away)
    await link_locator.click()
